scope: Own003 TunerStudio INI/transport audit against official definitions and pinned Speeduino serial source. Cache-only probes; no production edits, native rebuild, application patch/decompilation, identity spoofing, service restart, child agents or vendor messages.
verdict: Root fixed the transportF/layout identity defect and the reviewer independently rechecked it. Corrected actual TunerStudio MS Lite3.3.01 discovery explicitly rejects honest own003 before any read/edit/burn. One-page own004 with stable wire origin and separate internal CAS is a coherent proposed inhibited development contract, not a solution to this app-support boundary. Earlier own003 transaction/error/recovery findings remain recorded; implementation of own004 is outside this source review.

efi_definition.summary: The signature/query response selects the definition; versionInfo supplies display/version text. Definitions specify logical pages, byte order, commands and block sizes. Burn initiates flash persistence. Default page-change automatic burns precede further-page writes. The envelope is selected by INI; its separate specification is linked.

sections: How do I get support for my fuel injection controller?
efi_supported_ecu_path.summary: Official FAQ describes controller-specific adaptations and tells hardware vendors to work with EFI Analytics to add ECU support. This documents a vendor integration path, not a public promise that any own signature works in every TunerStudioMS edition.

efi_developer_commands.scope: Documents custom commands/buttons inside an ECU definition; it does not establish arbitrary controller identity acceptance.

speeduino.summary: F reports transport002; f reports protocol byte2 and block sizes. Framing is big-endian payload length, payload/status and CRC.84 means non-retry range error;85 requests retry. The receiver ignores an idleF0 reset byte and expires incomplete reception after400ms.

linked_envelope_reference.scope: EFI-linked document defines serial version separately from Q format identity and S display/version. Its cover limits stated applicability to listed MegaSquirt products; this audit uses verified pinned Speeduino behavior for comparison, not that document as a general controller-support authorization.

findings.finding: Initial own003 reused its layout revision for raw/framedF while f returned2. These are separate protocol identities.
findings.recommendation: Keep SERIAL_PROTOCOL002 separate from honest ESP32ECU SIL003 INHIBITED layout signature.

findings.finding: M ACK/p/CRC refer to per-connection staged buffers; active EngineStore updates only at b. Every successful b then repacks all pages with a new revision at page1 byte268, altering mapped bytes without a write from the client. baseRevision is an ordinary generated U32, with no ConstantExtensions readOnly declaration.
findings.recommendation: Define live RAM-apply versus persistence semantics explicitly. Keep server CAS revisions outside mutable page bytes or freeze/resynchronize them by a clear connection contract; do not silently renew a stale client snapshot.

findings.finding: Full-tune validation and automatic per-page burns can reject a valid multi-page transition midway.

evidence.qualification: Command ordering follows documented auto-burn-on-page-change; in-memory CAS store calls existing unchanged native engine_validate. No native rebuild or real app/session/flash use.

findings.recommendation: Choose/document transaction ordering compatible with default app burns, or a documented firmware-development auto-burn configuration and one explicit final commit. Test wholeMSQ loads as well as single-cell edits; per-page byte correctness is insufficient.

findings.finding: StaleCAS409 and storage-blocked503/507 all become85. Repeating the same request cannot clear those states, but85 asks the client to wait/retry.
findings.recommendation: Reserve85 for conditions that can resolve transiently. Permanent/stale failures need a non-retry result and explicit resynchronization/reconnect behavior.

findings.finding: PTY receiver lacks partial-frame expiry. A truncated frame retains later rawF as payload; idleF0 followed byF is consumed as an invalid large length and loses the discovery command. TCP has a2s partial-buffer timeout/close, while INI client timeout is also2s.
findings.recommendation: Use a bounded receive deadline shorter than client timeout; clear/recover incomplete state. Ignore reset bytes only at idle, preserving arbitrary binary payload bytes.

findings.finding: CorrectedF002 discovery completes through I/f00/fFF/Q; unchanged TunerStudio MS Lite3.3.01 explicitly rejects honest ESP32ECU SIL003 INHIBITED before any page/read/edit/burn request.

evidence.interpretation_limit: Trace shows requests/replies, not app internal reason or a current own003 outcome.

current_app_reproduction.exact_warning: Unsupported Controller Firmware: ESP32ECU SIL 003 INHIBITED

findings.recommendation: Retain honest identity and distinguish wire correctness from app support. The official reviewed support path is ECU vendor coordination with EFI Analytics. Do not describe own004 as a signature workaround; there is no reviewed arbitrary-identity self-service acceptance mechanism.

checks_that_passed.identity: Q is26-byte own signature matching INI exactly. S is59-byte display text; no general length fault was established. Keep these distinct from F.
checks_that_passed.wire: Silent empty feed,14 split-frame boundaries, coalesced discovery/binary requests, status-inclusiveCRC, wrongCRC82, little-endian command fields and big-endian envelope/CRC pass in-memory probes.
checks_that_passed.INI: Five logical pages and sizes match pages();256-byte blocking capabilities and184-byte output block match generated definition. Own layout signature is preserved; no vendor identity substitution.
checks_that_passed.source_snapshot: Only root transportF decoupling changed between the initial copied protocol and current discovery recheck; other reproduced code paths remain unchanged.

verification_limits: In-memory fixtures model CAS/persistence results; no actual file/flash/live plant was exercised. Cross-page probe also calls the existing native validator byCDLL without rebuilding it.
Reviewer did not launch or modify the app. Root owns actual unchanged-app reproduction; reviewer parsed and CRC-validated all512 request/response pairs and bound debug log, INI and app JAR hashes.
No physical UART or target execution; current tuning_server is local TCP/PTY SIL and current live_block reports a completed historical snapshot.

next_revision_design_review.assessment: Conditionally coherent single-page staged transaction; explicit reset/automatic-burn/CAS contracts and target USB SDK lifecycle/OOM/cache limits are specified.
